implementationNotes: The approved scope is Windows desktop v0.1 only and is not reopened by this coordination record.
Transfer, persistence, URL intake, filename, collision, and lifecycle business rules must have one shared Rust domain/service owner consumed by the Tauri UI and Windows adapters.
Manual URL entry and clipboard offers must converge on the same validation path; clipboard detection must never start a transfer without confirmation.
User-visible behavior requires real DOM, browser, integration, or equivalent runtime evidence; source-pattern assertions do not qualify.
No production deployment, production credential use, destructive database operation, Git branch operation, or commit is part of this workstream.
knownRisks: Root workspace and license deliverables cannot be created under the current allowedPaths and require an explicitly expanded approved boundary.
No application implementation exists yet, so no product behavior, buildability, accessibility, or runtime performance claim is currently supported.
HTTP server variance, restart-safe segment persistence, byte-correct assembly, Windows path rules, shell-action failure, and clipboard privacy are high-risk implementation areas.
Tauri Windows builds depend on a compatible Rust toolchain, Node tooling, Microsoft C++ build tools, and WebView2 availability.
Independent verification remains pending until ENG-15 reproduces the finished implementation.
